_comment: IROS demo: a full fleet working a 16-turbine farm.
wind + wake            the farm itself: Larsen wake, regions streamed to
Unity with the radial profile and turbulence, LCOE.
bluerov_orbit_*        octagons around a monopile, 50 m radius, 12 m deep,
bluerov_inspect_*      58 m and 22 m deep with YOLO fault inspection. Both
run the full GNC loop under xdyn and Ekman.
lrauv_orbit_*          octagons at 66 m, 32 m deep, waypoint_follower.
lrauv_tour_*           cross a turbine row at 40 m deep, generic GNC loop.
wamv_aisle_*           run the aisle between two rows or two columns.
wamv_fig8_*            figure of eight around a group of four turbines.
x500_orbit_*           hexagons around a mast, 12 m radius, 30 m up.
wamv_drift_*           drift with the Ekman current, navigation only.
lrauv_drift_*          same, with the propeller held at a resting command.
bluerov_crack          static underwater crack detection, window shown.
x500_crack_inspection  static aerial crack detection, window shown.
Orbit polygons have 6 to 8 vertices so each leg is long enough for the
guidance to settle, and their tolerance is a third of a leg.
The turbine foundation reaches 38 m from the mast axis. The orbit radii
keep every controlled vehicle outside it.
One xdyn process is started per agent class, from the first agent of that
class in this list: a class mixing xdyn and Kinematic agents must list an
xdyn one first.
world_file stays energy.world although bluerov_current is ekman:
bluerov_ekman.world carries the 47 deg latitude and 0.05 s step the model
was validated with, but its geographic origin is 370 km away and the patrol
files are lat/lon.
crack_detector needs a CUDA GPU.
